help_0x14: AT+DEBUG:Set more info input\r\n
ATZ: Trig a reset of the MCU\r\n
AT+FDR: Reset Parameters to Factory Default, Keys Reserve\r\n
AT+DEUI: Get or Set the Device EUI\r\n
AT+APPEUI: Get or Set the Application EUI\r\n
AT+APPKEY: Get or Set the Application Key\r\n
AT+DADDR: Get or Set the Device Address\r\n
AT+NWKSKEY: Get or Set the Network Session Key\r\n
AT+APPSKEY: Get or Set the Application Session Key\r\n
AT+ADR: Get or Set the Adaptive Data Rate setting. (0: off, 1: on)\r\n
AT+DR: Get or Set the Data Rate. (0-7 corresponding to DR_X)\r\n
AT+PNM: Get or Set the public network mode. (0: off, 1: on)\r\n
AT+RX2FQ: Get or Set the Rx2 window frequency\r\n
AT+RX2DR: Get or Set the Rx2 window data rate (0-7 corresponding to DR_X)\r\n
AT+NJM: Get or Set the Network Join Mode. (0: ABP, 1: OTAA)\r\n
AT+NWKID: Get or Set the Network ID\r\n
AT+FCU: Get or Set the Frame Counter Uplink\r\n
AT+FCD: Get or Set the Frame Counter Downlink\r\n
AT+CLASS: Get or Set the Device Class\r\n
AT+JOIN: Join network\r\n
AT+NJS: Get the join status\r\n
AT+SENDB: Send hexadecimal data along with the application port\r\n
AT+SEND: Send text data along with the application port\r\n
AT+RECVB: Print last received data in binary format (with hexadecimal values)\r\n
AT+RECV: Print last received data in raw format\r\n
AT+DWELLT: Get or set UplinkDwellTime\r\n
AT+RJTDC: Get or set the ReJoin data transmission interval in min\r\n
AT+RPL: Get or set response level\r\n
AT+VER: Get current image version and Frequency Band\r\n
AT+CFM: Get or Set the confirmation mode (0-1)\r\n
AT+CFS: Get confirmation status of the last AT+SEND (0-1)\r\n
AT+SNR: Get the SNR of the last received packet\r\n
AT+RSSI: Get the RSSI of the last received packet\r\n
AT+TDC: Get or set the application data transmission interval in ms\r\n
AT+PORT: Get or set the application port\r\n
AT+DECRYPT: Get or Set the Decrypt the uplink payload(0:Disable,1:Enable)\r\n
AT+MOD:Get or Set the work mode\r\n
AT+WEIGRE:Set the weight to 0g\r\n
AT+WEIGAP:Get or Set the GapValue of weight\r\n
AT+5VT:Get or Set extend the time of 5V power\r\n
AT+SETCNT: Get or set the count at present\r\n
AT+CHS: Get or Set Frequency (Unit: Hz) for Single Channel Mode\r\n
AT+CHE: Get or Set eight channels mode,Only for US915,AU915,CN470\r\n
AT+GETSENSORVALUE: Returns the current sensor value\r\n
AT+DDETECT: Get or set the downlink detection\r\n
AT+SETMAXNBTRANS: Get or set the max nbtrans in LinkADR\r\n
AT+DISFCNTCHECK: Get or set the Downlink Frame Check(0:Enable,1:Disable)\r\n
AT+DISMACANS: Get or set the MAC ANS switch(0:Enable,1:Disable)\r\n
AT+RXDATEST: Set the downlink data detection\r\n
AT+CFG: Print all configurations\r\n
